visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short black hair and glasses, wearing a white sweatshirt with colorful "CHEERS" text, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. She smiles and holds up two wide, yellow pasta dough strips toward the camera. The background features white cabinets, wooden shelves with jars, and a coffee machine. (2) A close-up shot shows a mound of white flour on a marble countertop with a well in the center. A person's hands crack two eggs into the well. The lighting is bright and even. A small circular graphic of the woman and a flour package are visible as overlays. (3) The woman uses her hands to knead a ball of yellow dough on the white countertop. Her movements are firm and steady. The camera is at a medium-close range, focusing on her upper body and the physical activity on the counter. (4) A long, rectangular sheet of dough lies on the white counter. A hand uses a wooden ruler and a fluted pastry wheel to slice the dough into small, decorative rectangles. The scene is shot from a top-down perspective, emphasizing the precision of the cutting. (5) Hands carefully pinch the centers of the small dough rectangles to create butterfly-shaped farfalle. A miniature animated version of the woman appears lying on one of the pasta pieces. The background is slightly blurred, focusing strictly on the intricate hand movements. (6) A tray is filled with neatly arranged rows of uncooked farfalle pasta. The camera zooms in slightly, showing the consistent shape and texture of the dough pieces. The lighting remains bright, highlighting the pale yellow color of the fresh pasta. (7) A blue bowl contains cooked farfalle with clams, garlic, and green herbs. A fork lifts a piece of pasta, showing its three-dimensional shape. The scene transitions to the pasta boiling in a pot of water and then back to the finished plated dish. (8) A brown tabby cat walks across the white kitchen sink area. The woman enters the frame from the left and leans toward the cat. The kitchen looks clean and well-lit, with various high-end appliances visible in the background.
